text:
maria: heads up — planning a maintenance window for az14 tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC. NIC microcode update from vendor to fix egress queue oscillation. Affects egress QoS shaping on racks that host gpu-pool-az14-primary.

sam: noted. what's the expected impact on hosted vs dedicated?

maria: hosted: short transient increased p95 latency as few racks are drained then warmed. Dedicated: should be isolated but some racks host mixed tenants so we need to cordon a small cohort. will run canary on r6-cc1 then roll by cohort.

li: can we avoid evicting active long-lived KV cache sessions? those are causing perf cliffs in the past.

maria: yes — plan is graceful drain (no eviction) + prefix cache warmup after reboot. steps: cordon -> migrate new requests -> wait 120s for in-flight to finish -> reboot NIC -> uncordon and run warmup traffic.

james: do we have capacity to backfill if a cohort takes longer? cost implications if we spin up burst dedicated.

sre-lead: we can backfill with spot in the same AZ but prefer routing to eu fallback for latency-sensitive SLAs. For Dedicated customers, we’ll shift to reserved spare pool (reduces throughput by ~15%). cost tradeoff: short-term spot burst estimated $1.2k for 2h vs reserved pool usage counted toward committed capacity.

ops-bot: PRECHECKS: run ./scripts/preflight-az14.sh (exit 0 required). Patch version must be 1.4.9.

maria: preflight checklist posted in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az14-egoqos. key checks: kernel NIC driver >=5.11.16, oss-lro disabled, BMC firmware latest.

li: can we try a micro-canary: 2 nodes in r6-cc1 at 03:00, observe packet drops and p95 for 15m, then continue?

maria: yep that's the plan. canary window 03:00-03:30. rollback if packet-drop >0.1% or p95 increase >60ms.

sam: who's oncall for that window?

oncall-bot: maria (primary), sam (secondary), james (infra follow), li (perf). Paging schedule sent to rotations channel.

james: I'll prepare a post-rollback remediation play: quick revert by reapplying old microcode + switch routing to eu-fallback. Will also open a billing ticket if spot costs exceed estimate.

maria: tagging product/sales before we start so they can flag high-traffic tenants. @sre-lead please ping customer success if we need manual cover for enterprise Dedicated tenants.

sre-lead: will do. also adding extra tracing hooks and increasing observability retention for 1h around the window. dashboards: Console -> Fleet -> az14 -> egress-qos, and traces: https://op-traces/az14/trace-portal.

li: one more ask — include a small synthetic workload to warm prefix cache: ~100 short requests per node with seq_len=256 after uncordon. I'll provide the script.

maria: perfect. final checklist: preflight by 01:00 UTC, canary at 03:00, roll cohorts every 15m, backfill plan active. I'll post a final notice in #announcements 1h before. :thumbsup:

sam: ack :rotating_light: (reaction :thumbsup: from james)

maria: thanks everyone — will update this thread with any changes.
